== Notes ==
* This skill will end prematurely if the caster [[Death|dies]].
* This skill works effectively as a [[cover]] hex due to its low energy cost, cool down, and fixed duration. The healing notably provides a visual cue to the user when it is removed. 
* It is best not to remove Parasitic Bond if it is the only hex you or an ally is suffering from, because of numerous factors: the health degeneration it causes is negligible, removing it will heal the caster, it can be reapplied once it is removed due to its short recharge time, and it will end automatically once the caster [[Death|dies]] anyway.
*If you cast this skill on a target which an ally has already put Parasitic Bond on, you will gain two [[packet]]s of healing. One for when theirs would have normally ended, and one when yours ends.
